description: A cybersecurity incident reported by a downtown financial firm, data breach under investigation.
A vehicle was reported stolen from the Northgate shopping center parking lot. The car is a 2022 red Ford Mustang.
Vandalism reported at the city park. Graffiti was found on a public bench near the main fountain.
Shoplifting incident at a local electronics store. Suspect apprehended by store security.
Break-in at a residential property on Elm Street. Electronics were reported stolen.
A minor hit-and-run incident occurred at the intersection of First and Main. No injuries.
Report of a loud public disturbance involving multiple individuals near the park entrance.
Illegal firework usage reported in a residential neighborhood, causing noise complaints.
Theft of a package from a residential porch on Oak Avenue. Captured on a security camera.
A fraudulent street performance scam was reported near the tourist plaza. No money was lost.
A case of identity theft was reported online, originating from a phishing email.
Minor property damage due to a traffic collision. Both parties exchanged insurance information.
